blogs.title: Finetuning Giant AI Models on a Single Consumer GPU: The QLoRA Revolution
blogs.description: This post breaks down the core breakthrough of the QLoRA paper: how researchers managed to finetune massive 65-billion-parameter language models on a single 48GB GPU. We'll explain the problem of memory constraints in traditional finetuning and how QLoRA shatters those barriers, democratizing access to state-of-the-art AI development for individuals and small labs.

blogs.title: Beyond Bits: How 'NormalFloat' and Double Quantization Save Memory Without Losing Smarts
blogs.description: Dive into the technical innovations that make QLoRA possible. This article simplifies complex concepts like 4-bit NormalFloat (NF4)—a custom data type optimized for neural network weights—and Double Quantization, which compresses the metadata itself. Learn how these tricks drastically cut memory usage while ensuring the model doesn't lose its intelligence.

blogs.title: Meet Guanaco: The Open-Source Chatbot That Rivals ChatGPT Without the Price Tag
blogs.description: Explore the results of applying QLoRA to create 'Guanaco,' a family of chatbots that reached 99.3% of ChatGPT's performance on major benchmarks. We'll discuss why high-quality, smaller datasets beat massive ones, how these models outperform larger competitors despite having fewer parameters, and what this means for the future of open-source AI.

blogs.title: Are Benchmarks Broken? Evaluating Chatbots with Humans vs. GPT-4
blogs.description: The paper reveals surprising insights about how we judge AI performance. This post analyzes the study's findings on evaluation methods, comparing human ratings against automated GPT-4 assessments. We'll discuss why current benchmarks might be misleading, where automated tools succeed or fail, and why a 'tournament-style' Elo rating system offers a clearer picture of chatbot capabilities.
